identityMigration.title: Job identity migration
identityMigration.intro: This update gives each job a permanent identity. Prepare a verified backup first, save a separate copy, and then explicitly start the migration. Existing backup archives stay in their repositories.

stage.backup_ready: Backup verified: save a separate copy
stage.acknowledged: Separate copy acknowledged: ready for your decision

hint.required: Normal plugin functions remain paused until the migration and final checks succeed. Opening this page does not start the migration.
hint.waiting: Existing work must finish safely and required storage must be available. No running backup is stopped to force migration.
hint.preparing: The application creates an exact backup of the affected data and checks its completeness, sizes and checksums. You may close this page and return later.
hint.backup_ready: The application has verified the backup. Download it and save a checked copy on separate storage before continuing.
hint.acknowledged: Acknowledging your copy has not started conversion. Use the separate action below when you are ready.
hint.applying: The authorized operation continues on the server. Closing or reopening this page does not start another operation.
hint.verifying: Normal plugin functions stay paused until all final integrity checks succeed.
hint.interrupted: The original plan and backup are retained. Continue only when the server has verified that this attempt can safely resume. Do not delete the recovery data.
hint.complete: The migration and final integrity checks succeeded. Keep your separate backup until you no longer need it.

identityMigration.pathHint: Use a dedicated directory on mounted, persistent storage that supports private file permissions. The application checks the location before writing. The Unraid USB boot device is not suitable.
identityMigration.confidential: This backup may contain credentials and other confidential data. Store it securely and do not attach it to a public issue or forum post.
identityMigration.independentCopy: Save and check a separate copy, for example on another device. Your acknowledgement records your confirmation; it cannot prove that an external copy exists.
identityMigration.acknowledgement: I have saved and checked a separate copy of the backup. I understand that it may contain confidential data.
identityMigration.acknowledgedPause: The separate copy has been acknowledged. The migration is still waiting for your explicit start.
identityMigration.applyDescription: Starting now authorizes conversion using this exact plan and verified backup. The server checks storage, unchanged source data and idle workers again before writing.
identityMigration.restartRequired: Normal operation requires a successful plugin restart after the cause has been corrected. Preserve the original plan, backup and migration log.
identityMigration.requestFailed: The action could not be confirmed (HTTP {status}). Check the current status before continuing.
identityMigration.invalidStatus: The server returned an invalid migration status.
identityMigration.statusUnavailable: The current migration status could not be loaded. Actions are paused until the connection is restored. Previously authorized work may still be running.
identityMigration.changedBackup: The backup or plan changed. Check the current backup and confirm it again.

reasons.active_workers: Existing backup, restore, test or notification work is still running. Wait for it to finish safely.
reasons.storage_unavailable: Required storage is unavailable. Mount it in Unraid and refresh the status.
reasons.snapshot_unverified: The backup could not be verified. Preserve the recovery data and review the migration details.
reasons.source_changed: Source data changed after preparation. The previous confirmation no longer authorizes migration.
reasons.independent_backup_required: Save and check a separate copy of the verified backup, then confirm it here.
reasons.writers_active: Existing background work is still running. Wait for it to finish safely and refresh the status.
reasons.migration_maintenance: The migration keeps normal write operations paused.
reasons.gate_storage_unavailable: The storage for the migration gate is unavailable. Check mounted storage in Unraid.
reasons.unsafe_gate_path: The migration gate path cannot be used safely. Check its path and permissions.
reasons.persistent_private_storage_required: Choose mounted, persistent storage that supports private file permissions.
reasons.state_filesystem_unsupported: The filesystem does not support the required private permissions or safe file operations. Choose a suitable backup location.
reasons.approval_required: The migration is waiting for your explicit approval of this plan and backup.
reasons.input_changed: Source data changed after preparation. The previous approval is no longer valid. Preserve the existing backup.
reasons.inventory_changed: The inventory of affected files changed. Migration remains paused for review.
reasons.snapshot_changed: The backup changed after verification. Migration remains paused; preserve all recovery data.
reasons.invalid_snapshot: The backup is inconsistent. Preserve it and review migration diagnostics before continuing.
reasons.snapshot_incomplete: The backup is incomplete. Conversion has not been authorized. Preserve the existing state.
reasons.insufficient_space: The backup location does not have enough free space.
reasons.independent_backup_ack_required: Save and check a separate copy of the backup and acknowledge it here.
reasons.restart_required: Correct the reported cause and restart the plugin. Preserve the plan, backup and migration log.
reasons.explicit_continuation_required: An earlier operation was interrupted. Validated continuation requires another explicit action.
reasons.original_migration_location_required: Use the original migration location containing the existing plan and backup.
reasons.verification_failed: Integrity verification failed. Normal functions remain paused. Preserve all recovery data.
reasons.unsafe_path: A required path cannot be used safely. Check storage, links and file permissions.
reasons.invalid_plan: The saved plan could not be validated. Preserve the recovery data for diagnosis.
reasons.state_conflict: The saved migration state is ambiguous. Automatic continuation is blocked.
reasons.invalid_journal: The migration journal could not be validated. Preserve all files for diagnosis.
reasons.interrupted: The previous operation was interrupted. Preserve the original plan and backup.
reasons.not_applicable: This inventory does not require migration.

identityMigration.maintenanceDescription: Normal plugin functions are paused. Migration status and protected diagnostics remain available. Unraid array and pool controls remain available in Unraid.

identity.target_changed: The earlier restore proof applies to another repository or archive prefix.
identity.target_unknown: The repository or archive prefix of the earlier restore proof is unknown.
